cqr.sharing: uncalibrated/CQR share exact raw lower/upper/median owner; levels have distinct objects
cqr.score: native static: separate raw_lower-y and y-raw_upper tail scores; method-preserving online replay: max(raw_lower-y,y-raw_upper)
cqr.native_quantile: asymmetric native tails: numpy.quantile(each tail score, (1-(1-level)/2)*(1+1/n), method=higher); MAPIE 1.4.1
cqr.crossing: retain raw pair; order only emitted pair

enbpi.sharing: static/updated and both nominal levels share exact final calibrated owner; updates never mutate it
enbpi.operations: fit: full-data estimator plus five training bootstraps; explicit conformalize: five calibration bootstraps; verify synthetic actual ledger before real freeze
enbpi.native_score: installed MAPIE conformity score with OOB predictions; retain nonfinite OOB score counts explicitly
enbpi.native_interval: original _recentered_intervals; native offsets shifted from ensemble to full-fit point; no test-truth fitting

updated_policy.initialization: fixed pre-test same-group calibration history, otherwise fixed whole historical pool; global supported quantiles as initial hold
updated_policy.quantile: lower floor((n+1)*(1-level)/2+1e-12), upper ceil((n+1)*(1-(1-level)/2)-1e-12), one-indexed; no interpolation
updated_policy.group_policy: isolated original group and contiguous segment; reset to fixed historical calibration
updated_policy.legacy_difference: legacy updated EnbPI used interpolated numpy quantiles/min_samples1; this named adapter preserves amendment004 ranks/min_samples50; no bit-identity claim

dscp.quantile: numpy.quantile default linear on fixed cluster/merged-step error pool
dscp.assignment: soft-DTW to all calibration predicted sequences; smallest-cluster-size neighbours; argpartition then majority/lowest-index tie
dscp.owner: verified historical matched XGBoost direct horizon artifacts

replay.release: compare matured observation to its immutable issued bounds before release; target_time <= current origin; available readings only
replay.static: uncalibrated/CQR/static EnbPI/DSCP keep native static construction
replay.availability: original target_was_missing and finite source observation; imputed does not imply observed

alert.events: empty; background workload only; no recall/F1/delay/primary feasibility
